Hi Nora — thanks, and welcome. I'm the SE who'll run the technical portion. Two quick things on scheduling and artifacts so we set expectations and make the session productive: 

1) Timing: 16:30 CET on Tue 2027-09-07 converts to 07:30 PT on our side. We can do 16:30 CET (07:30 PT) but it pushes some of our engineers into an early shift. If that works for your team we will staff it. Alternatively we can offer 15:30–16:30 CET (06:30–07:30 PT) which is a slightly earlier overlap but still feasible.

2) Pre-demo evidence: I can share a SOC2 summary and the network prep doc ahead of the call. I'll upload the SOC2 one to our secure share; attached here is a short summary we typically provide (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf). If your compliance team needs the full report we will coordinate an NDA/legal channel — please let me know.

3) Agenda suggestion for the 60-min slot (we'll tailor once attendees are confirmed):
 - 10 min: introductions & architecture overview (isolation model)
 - 25 min: network & operational walkthrough (peering, egress, KMS integration)
 - 15 min: security controls & observability (audit logs, retention)
 - 10 min: Q&A / next steps (pilot, evidence exchange)

Final question: please confirm attendee list (names + roles) and whether you need a recording for internal review.

Attaching: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

If 16:30 CET is the only workable time for your leaders, confirm and I'll mark our team to staff it.

Thanks,
Priyom
